prospective_predictions.claim: on every registered world and every observation, with Q = Q_full and a correctly specified model, the F-minimizer equals the exact Bayes posterior and min F equals -log2 P(o) exactly
on W_CORR the mean-field minimum free energy exceeds the unrestricted minimum by exactly 1 bit
on W_TRI_MIS at o0 the model posterior is (1/2,0,1/2) and the true posterior is (1/2,1/2,0); they differ

on W_AMB, for EVERY C in the registered dyadic family, G(a0) - G(a1) = 1 bit exactly while EU(a0) - EU(a1) = 1/2 exactly, so no preference prior makes expected free energy reproduce the utility ordering
on W_DISC1 expected free energy selects a1, cardinality-1 rate-distortion control selects a0, and the CPC family selects all three of a0, a1 and a2 as lambda ranges over the AE8 grid
on W_AGREE1 all three selectors choose b0
MARKOV_BLANKET_EXISTS is True on SYS_MB_OK and False on SYS_MB_FAIL under an exhaustive search over all partitions into non-empty internal, blanket and external sets
the parent-sufficiency terminal fires for perception-as-Bayes at the registered scope, so no novelty is claimed there

registered_constants.dyadic_rule: every probability in every registered table is 0 or 2**-k for an integer k>=0; every row sums to 1
registered_constants.efe_convention: G(a) = risk(a) + ambiguity(a); risk(a) = KL(Pa(o)||C); ambiguity(a) = E_{s~Pa}[H(L(.|s))]; horizon H = 1
registered_constants.free_energy_convention: F(q,o) = KL(q||P0) - E_q[log2 L(o|s)], in bits; F = INF (the string "INF") when q charges a state with L(o|s)=0
registered_constants.null_sampler: uniform over dyadic likelihood tables on the registered shape with the per-outcome dyadic-marginal constraint
registered_constants.tie_break: lexicographic by the registered action/model name, ascending

SYS_MB_FAIL.note: parity constraint v0 = v1 XOR v2; every variable is determined by the other two

SYS_MB_OK.note: v0 = v1; v2 free; the chain v0 - v1 - v2 admits a blanket

W_AMB.note: both actions induce the identical predicted outcome distribution (1/2,1/2); they differ only in ambiguity

W_CORR.note: L(o0|s)=1 exactly on {s00,s11}; the o0-posterior is perfectly correlated and lies outside every product distribution

W_TRI_MIS.note: the agent holds W_TRI with rows s1 and s2 exchanged
